✓ Queen's Royal Hussars.question: On return from _____ in 2012 the regiment was called on to support the security for the London Olympic Games
✓ Queen's Royal Hussars.fact: In 2011 the regiment deployed on Operation Herrick 15 as a ground holding Battle Group to Afghanistan in the infantry role: they worked with the Afghan National Police handing over control of checkpoints. On return from Afghanistan in 2012 the regiment was called on to support the security for the London Olympic Games.

✓ Queen's Royal Hussars.question: In January 2025 they became one of the first regiments to be outfitted with the new _____ armoured fighting vehicle
